profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, and traded under the ticker SOUN. According to its website, its OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that handle service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The company describes its offering as conversational AI agents for the real world.

The site presents customer accounts of the technology in use. One describes using the company's agentic AI to resolve more requests faster, improve interaction quality, and scale operations as demand grows. Another says the voice AI lets franchisees process orders more efficiently and supports employees during peak hours, producing a fast and consistent ordering experience. A third cites hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity as enabling always-on voice experiences for customers on the go.

The company's SEC Central Index Key is 0001840856. Its recorded litigation exposure sits in Delaware, with a count of 33. Beyond the OASYS platform, no individual products are named in the available material.
